theme: Hybrid Dark/Light - Default to Dark 'Obsidian'. Brutalist, Premium, Futuristic, Minimal.

brand_identity.tone: Quiet dominance, confident, minimal, intimidating, no hype words.
brand_identity.tagline: Just getting started. Going to the top.

company_facts.name: OKI Inc.
company_facts.hq: One World Trade Center 85th Floor New York NY 10007

constraints: NEVER claim OKI holds assets, portfolios, or cold storage.
Email links must open Gmail compose directly (https://mail.google.com/mail/?view=cm&fs=1&to=contact@okiinc.global&su=Inquiry)
Contact page has NO forms. Informational only.
DO NOT MAKE THIS WEBSITE LOOK AI-GENERATED.

fonts.headings: Clash Display (Variable or bold/black weights with tight tracking)
fonts.mono: JetBrains Mono (Used for all tickers, live data, micro-copy, UI labels)

scale.h1: text-5xl sm:text-7xl lg:text-8xl tracking-tighter uppercase leading-none

rules: NO generic font fallbacks for headings. No Inter or Roboto.
Use JetBrains Mono for data points to contrast with Satoshi body.
Massive contrast between H1 and body text.
Tinted Grey Rule: Dark backgrounds are slightly warm to match the gold accent.
Gold (#C5A059) is for highlights, 1px borders, subtle glows, and hover states. Never massive blocks of gold.
Avoid default Tailwind colors unless explicitly styled for market data (e.g., market up/down).

general: Strict Swiss Grid with deliberate asymmetry.
High density for Markets terminal, massive negative space for marketing sections.
Use 'Grid Borders' - visible 1px borders (#1a1a1a or #D5CEBD) on containers to create the 'architectural' feel.

spacing.generous: p-8 md:p-16 lg:p-24 for marketing sections.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise/grain overlay on the entire site (pointer-events-none, fixed, opacity-20).
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px sharp borders everywhere. 0px border-radius (sharp edges only).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only for the sticky minimal navigation and HUD elements. No muddy transparency. High blur (backdrop-blur-xl), slight saturation, 1px sharp inner border.
visual_enhancers.cursor: Custom minimal cursor (e.g., small gold dot or inverted blend mode circle) that expands on hoverables.
visual_enhancers.theme_toggle: System-aware light/dark toggle seamlessly integrated into navigation.

motion.scroll: Lenis smooth scroll is MANDATORY. High momentum, premium feel.
motion.page_transitions: Black veil wipe or dissolve on route changes (Framer Motion).
micro_interactions: Click sounds (subtle UI ticks, like a high-end terminal).
Subtle parallax on images and background elements.

3d_libraries.hero_element: React Three Fiber (R3F) + Drei. A slow-rotating, dark monolithic geometric shape (like an obsidian obelisk or brutalist architecture piece) or an abstract WebGL globe reflecting market data.
3d_libraries.performance: Ensure <Suspense> is used. Must not block main thread. Keep GPU-friendly transforms.

components.navigation: Sticky, transparent at top, transforms to glassmorphism on scroll. Minimal items. Premium full-screen mobile menu.
components.hero: Cinematic. Massive H1, R3F 3D element, live NYC telemetry HUD overlay (time, coordinates, market status).
components.markets_board: Split board 'Crypto | Stocks'. JetBrains Mono heavy. High density. Toggle for Prices/Charts. Unified search.
components.strategy_blocks: Watch -> Study -> Publish doctrine. Editorial scroll-triggered transitions. 'Attention is the Strategy'.
components.about_hq: Architecture of the corp (Delaware C-Corp). One World Trade Center focus. Timeline and key facts. No fabricated numbers.
components.contact: No form. Tap-to-call. Gmail compose button. Day/Night aware 1WTC photo. Downloadable corporate PDF deck.

one_wtc_hero.description: Dramatic low angle shot of One World Trade Center. Use in Hero or Contact page.

brutalist_abstract.description: Black and white abstract brutalist structure. Use in About or Strategy sections.

market_data.description: Dark candlestick chart. Use in Insights or Markets page background.

accessibility: Semantic HTML elements strictly enforced (main, section, article, nav).
Heading hierarchy must be strictly logical (H1 -> H2 -> H3).
Focus states must be highly visible.
Contrast ratios must pass APCA standards.
Add aria-hidden='true' to all purely decorative elements.

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute using kebab-case and role-based naming (e.g., `data-testid='markets-toggle-button'`).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: USE .jsx EXTENSION FOR ALL REACT COMPONENTS. Do NOT use .tsx.
NEVER use generic AI assistant Emoji characters.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
DO NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). Target specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container. Optical alignment is key.
Zero border radius globally (sharp edges) to maintain the brutalist premium aesthetic.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers or overlays that sit above content.
Ensure SEO best practices (Meta tags, OG tags, semantic HTML) are implemented.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a high-end corporate identity platform mixed with a live market terminal. This is an Awwwards-level execution. Prioritize framer-motion animations, sharp typography, 1px borders, and a stark minimal palette. Integrate the provided Three.js/3D concepts elegantly without sacrificing performance. Ensure the email button strictly uses the Gmail compose link as specified. The contact page has no form. The overall feel is 'quiet dominance'.
